title: Make asking whether tests are needed the required step, not writing them
action: Turn planning's trailing test cell from an authoring obligation into a judgement. Edit only the bee-planning skill. Three jobs. FIRST, per D4: the trailing test cell stays unconditional — 'a code-touching slice with no test cell is a planning defect' survives verbatim — but its FIRST mandated step becomes a coverage judgment, not authoring. Write that into SKILL.md:76 and the expanded section at references/planning-reference.md:295-297: the cell cites the nearest existing tests by file:line and states whether they already cover the slice's acceptance criteria; covered means it caps by running those tests green and recording 'already covered, no new rows'; partly covered means it authors only the uncovered gap. State explicitly that a test cell which authors no test is NOT a defect, and that authoring rows which duplicate existing coverage is the waste this rule exists to stop. There is a worked instance to point at: docs/history/worker-conformance/reports/wc-3.md, where the judgment found four of five parts already pinned and closed only the real gap. SECOND, per D5: the test shape at lane standard and below is the triad — happy path, edge cases, error paths — at its smallest demonstrating size, and references/edge-dimensions.md's twelve dimensions stop being the default checklist at standard and apply only at high-risk and hard-gate work. Say why in one line: read as a checklist to fill, twelve dimensions generate volume. Add a short note at the top of edge-dimensions.md itself naming its new scope, so nobody reaches it by accident from a standard lane. THIRD, per D13, record the doctrine-versus-machine gap honestly where planners will meet it: SKILL.md's 'bugfix/high-risk stay per-cell red-first, never batched' permits what testCellDebt refuses — that predicate has no lane exemption and will refuse a feature close that has capped code-touching behavior or api cells and no test cell at all. Until the predicate learns the exemption, a high-risk feature still owes one trailing test cell. Do not fix the predicate here. Per D6 change nothing about the ratio ceiling or the new-suite rules — the triad is the shape guide, the ratio ceiling is the volume brake, and two brakes on one axis would contradict. Update references/provenance.md with the decision ids. Do not touch source. Regen is deferred to the orchestrator at wave close (wave-barrier).

The doctrine-versus-machine gap around testCellDebt is recorded where a planner will meet it
The ratio ceiling and new-suite rules are unchanged
